build.overlap: Same precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: All hosts use __now(). Native before/after rebuilt with identical console-only steady_clock patch. Sub-millisecond monotonic clock checks pass. Historical native timings used Date.now fallback; low-percent differences should be assessed within this paired run.
benchmarkScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
bootstrap="$PWD/$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-plural-magrinj-bytecode-path)"
run_variant() {
  case "$1" in
    before) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-number-grouping-hires "$2" ;;
    after) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-borrowed-number-hires "$2" ;;
    magrinj) FORMATJS_BENCH_BOOTSTRAP="$bootstrap" taskset -c 0 /tmp/hi-host-optimized "$2" ;;
  esac
}
for round in 1 2 3; do
  if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-list-default-overlap.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-borrowed-number-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-canonical-control.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-borrowed-number-tag-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-list-size-control.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-borrowed-number-size-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-canonical-locale-control.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-borrowed-number-locale-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
done
order: Three complete 33-case overlap invocations plus canonical and isolated Locale controls per host. Rounds 1 and 3 before/after/magrinj; round 2 reverses. No builds or profiling during timings. Constructor controls run separately afterward in the same alternating host order.
outputChecks: 423 values checked (297 overlap, 27 canonical tag controls, 18 isolated Locale controls, 45 list-size controls, 36 constructor controls). All FormatJS before/after values match. Only comparator differences, in overlap and constructor controls: omitted/unsupported ListFormat default locale en-US versus en.
change: Share borrowed number-piece traversal between owned parts and text. Latin digits and symbols can be borrowed; other digit mapping remains owned. Reuse the same rounded value and plural category for the new string path; retain general-pattern fallback.
